description: This file is a shell script that performs performance testing of the builtin FSMonitor feature in Git. It sets up repositories, enables/disables features like untracked cache and FSMonitor daemon, and runs various test matrices to measure performance impacts.

methods.name: enable_uc
methods.description: Enables the untracked cache in the specified repository.

methods.name: disable_uc
methods.description: Disables the untracked cache in the specified repository.

methods.name: start_fsm
methods.description: Starts the FSMonitor daemon and configures the repository to use it.

methods.name: stop_fsm
methods.description: Stops the FSMonitor daemon and unsets it from the repository configuration.

methods.name: do_status
methods.description: Runs a 'git status' command within the repo, timing the operation.

methods.name: do_matrix
methods.description: Runs a series of setup, modification, and status-retrieval steps under certain configurations to benchmark performance.
